protocol.selection: No cost scenario may be selected as a production setting or promotion evidence
protocol.sizing: Existing bankroll_1_percent and shared exposure caps, .07 fee, conservative cent rounding
protocol.frontier: Maximum extra price per contract preserving the existing one-contract .04 qualification; 0.0001 grid
protocol.fixed_cohort: Zero-slippage filled trades, same side/quantity for all cost scenarios; diagnostic only
protocol.restrictions: Previously inspected development dates; no training, new strategies or holdout access
